Pilot lesson: execution, proposal acceptance, checking, approval and professional reliance each retain their own actor/evidence. Successalone impliesnone; evidenceofoneactdoesnotestablishanother, and there is no synthetic dependency requiringacceptance before anyother independentlyevidencedact. Hostowns offering/recording/presentingacts, not theperson actualact. Ground OUT/AC/VER in assignedsource evidence, relevantseedclauses and acceptedopenissues; testsexpressverificationbutnevercreatescope. JointmappedSOWitems mustbequalifiedtothislocalcontribution. No converter/parity/finalizer/HTML; authorproductionINIT directly. Keep AUTHOR_RETURN concise: scope/owner/open/validation findings andactualsourcehashes, no newpacket/snapshotchain. Additional verified lessons: a deliverable that defines/carries adopted policy is not the actor deciding unresolved policy; retain actual owner/host policy decision responsibility. False attribution is prohibited, but faithful recording of an actually performed human act is allowed with decision actor distinct from recorder. Include a positive faithful-recording case when this distinction is part of the assigned scope, alongside fabrication negatives; do not invent a new policy or per-deliverable ritual. Preserve each exact open owner and point of need. Distinguish selected editions/current run basis from broader adoption; no instruction or acceptance pointer edits occur in this authoring assignment.
